h1:
Chiang Mai vs Phuket
which to choose?
intro: Torn between Chiang Mai and Phuket? Here is an honest, side-by-side comparison so you can pick the one that fits your trip — or fit both in.

blocks.html: Short answer: These two are polar opposites. Choose Chiang Mai (north) for temples, mountains, cafés, culture, cooler weather and lower costs. Choose Phuket (south) for the sea, beaches, island tours and nightlife. First-timers often pair Bangkok with one of them — or do both if time allows.

blocks.text: Chiang Mai vs Phuket at a glance

items: Pick Chiang Mai if you love temples, mountains, cafés, culture, cool air and lower costs
Pick Phuket if you want the sea, beaches, island tours and nightlife
With more time, do both — a ~2-hour direct flight apart, pairing north and south in one trip

faq.q: Chiang Mai or Phuket for a first trip?
faq.a: It depends on your taste — for culture, mountains, cafés and cool air choose Chiang Mai; for the sea and island tours choose Phuket. With several days, pairing Bangkok with one of them works best.

faq.q: Is combining Chiang Mai and Phuket worth it?
faq.a: Worth it with at least 8–10 days — they are in different regions but linked by a ~2-hour direct flight, giving you both the north (culture, mountains) and south (sea, islands) in one trip.
Chiang Mai is cheaper overall — accommodation, food and local transport — while Phuket costs more, especially beachfront stays and island tours in high season.
